original_title: Talk at GIScience Workshop "Time to Focus on Time"
original_content_full:
Talk at GIScience Workshop "Time to Focus on Time"

Today, 18 September 2012, Stefan Buschmann is giving a talk at GeoVisual Analytics Workshop, which is collocated to GIScience 2012 in Columbus, Ohio, and is entitled "Time to Focus on Time". He will present his paper on “Challenges and Approaches for the Visualization of Movement Trajectories in 3D Geovirtual Environments", which was co-authored by Matthias Trapp and Jürgen Döllner.
